summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of Pro Photo Sorter v1.4.0 (nested sub-folders + custom filename templates). All 7 requested test items PASSED against the public preview URL. Zero console errors. No functional defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsModal.jsx is now ~1050 lines — consider splitting each <section> (Theme, UI scale, Watermark, Filename Template, Batch Behavior) into its own file for maintainability.
App.js is still ~2700 lines, well over the 700-line guideline; extract toolbar, filmstrip, and destination pane as previously flagged.

SettingsModal.jsx line 617-633: the Object.entries(...).map(...).reduce(...) pattern for comma-joining React nodes works but is dense; a small helper (joinReactNodes) would be clearer and easier to test.

SettingsModal.jsx line 585: alreadySaved uses simple string equality on template text, which is fine, but the button's disabled title says 'This template is already in your saved list' whereas the requirement wording is 'button is disabled while the input equals a saved template' — behaviour matches; keep as-is.
seed_data_creation: Test wrote settings.customFilenameTemplates + settings.enableNestedSubfolders + a Wildlife nested sub-folder 'Ceremony2' into localStorage pps.state.v2 during the run. Reset if a virgin-state test is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.4.0 build badge = 'v1.4.0 · 2026-02-19' (bottom-right). Verified testids in browser: nested-subfolders-toggle / -toggle-label; template-error, template-suggest-<bad>, template-save-custom-btn, template-custom-chips, template-custom-chip-<id>, template-custom-delete-<id>; Tag Manager subfolder testids subfolder-toggle-<id>, subfolder-<id>; nested editor testids nested-editor-d<n>, nested-add-input-<parentId>, nested-add-btn-<parentId>, nested-row-<id>, nested-toggle-<id>, nested-name-<id>, nested-rename-btn-<id>, nested-delete-<id>; main-window cascade rows palette-row-subfolder-l0 / -l1 (l1 appears only when enableNestedSubfolders=true AND active parent has children). Electron-only flows (first-run Sample Folder copy, Restore Samples in Help panel) not tested here (out of scope for browser).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced. All UX requirements a2 / b1 / c1 for Custom Filename Templates and the recursive nested sub-folder editor + main-window LEVEL 2 cascade are wired correctly.
